title: Study flags prenatal neurodevelopmental risks from phthalates and bisphenols
summary: Prenatal exposure to certain chemicals, including phthalates and bisphenols, may affect children's cognitive development, according to an INSERM study published on October 20. The researchers are calling for stricter regulations on these substances.
